module: BitLocker® Windows Resume (winresume) in Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode with module Boot Manager in Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB validated to FIPS 140-2 under Cert. #3415 operating in FIPS mode
description: BitLocker® Windows Resume is an operating system loader which loads the Windows OS kernel (ntoskrnl.exe) and other boot stage binary image files, as well as previous operating system state information, when Windows has been previously put into a sleep or hibernate power state.
tested_configurations: Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB (x64) running on a Dell XPS 8700 with an Intel Core i7 with PAA
Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB (x64) running on a HP Compaq Pro 6305 with an AMD A4 with PAA
Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB (x64) running on a Microsoft Surface 3 with an Intel Atom x7 with PAA
Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB (x64) running on a Microsoft Surface Pro 2 with an Intel Core i5 with PAA
Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB (x64) running on a Microsoft Surface Pro 3 with an Intel Core i7 with PAA
Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB (x64) running on a Microsoft Surface Pro with an Intel x64 Processor with PAA (single-user mode)
Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB (x86) running on a Dell Inspiron 660s with an Intel Core i3 without PAA
